hospitalsData.name: MetroHealth Regional Medical Center
hospitalsData.overview: MetroHealth Regional Medical Center is the flagship medical complex equipped with 450 beds, a premier cardiac arrest resuscitation unit, and comprehensive diagnostic imaging suites.

reviews.author: Robert Jenkins
reviews.comment: Brought my father to the emergency room with severe chest pain. From triage to ECG was under 6 minutes. The cardiology team is world-class.

reviews.author: Maria Vasquez
reviews.comment: Extremely clean facilities and courteous nursing staff. The pediatric wing took wonderful care of my daughter during her asthma flare-up.

reviews.author: David Vance
reviews.comment: Excellent doctors and rapid lab results. Parking was slightly busy, but the digital check-in on MediTrust made admittance painless.

hospitalsData.name: St. Jude Specialty Hospital & Heart Institute

reviews.author: Eleanor Vance
reviews.comment: My pacemaker implantation here was flawless. The cardiologists explained every detail with patience and warmth.

reviews.author: Thomas Wright
reviews.comment: Top-tier diagnostic scans. Received my calcium score and heart report within two hours via the portal.

hospitalsData.name: Sunrise Children’s & Family Medical Center
hospitalsData.overview: Dedicated exclusively to the health and recovery of infants, children, and expectant mothers in a calm, comforting environment.

reviews.author: Sarah Higgins
reviews.comment: The doctors here treat children like their own. My 3-year-old was scared of needle pricks, and the nurses used child play therapy to calm him.

reviews.author: Priya Sharma
reviews.comment: Delivered our first baby at Sunrise Maternity. The obstetricians and lactation consultants were incredible.

hospitalsData.name: Apex Orthopedic & Spine Institute

reviews.author: Kevin Brooks
reviews.comment: ACL reconstruction by Dr. Vance’s orthopedic colleagues. Back on my feet faster than expected thanks to the physical rehab team.

hospitalsData.name: Mercy Community Health & Urgent Care
hospitalsData.overview: Mercy Community delivers fast, compassionate care for sudden illnesses, minor injuries, routine health screenings, and continuous diabetes management.

reviews.author: Anita Patel
reviews.comment: Super fast urgent care. I had a deep cut on my hand requiring stitches and was treated and bandaged within 25 minutes total.

hospitalsData.name: Beacon Neuro-Science & Comprehensive Cancer Center
hospitalsData.overview: Recognized nationally for groundbreaking neurovascular interventions, stroke recovery, and individualized oncology treatments.

reviews.author: Gregory Miller
reviews.comment: Exceptional neurological care after a stroke. The physical and speech therapists here are miracle workers.

reviews.author: Farah Ansari

reviews.author: Vikram Desai

reviews.author: Claire Dubois

reviews.author: Angela Ruiz

reviews.author: Tomasz Nowak
reviews.comment: Pricier than outside options but worth it for the on-site pharmacy and fast checkout on treatment days.

reviews.author: Harold Bennett

reviews.author: Simone Carter
reviews.comment: The physio-friendly layout and closeness to Apex made daily rehab sessions so much easier for my mother.

reviews.author: Ravi Menon
reviews.comment: Simple and affordable for a short pre-surgery stay. Not built for long recovery but fine for a few nights.

reviews.author: Preeti Kulkarni
reviews.comment: Being one floor above the CCU meant we could see my husband within two minutes, any hour of the night.

reviews.author: Wanjiru Kamau

reviews.author: Ben Okoro

reviews.author: Grace Liu
reviews.comment: Quiet, calm, and genuinely restful during six weeks of radiation therapy. The shuttle timing matched our appointment slots perfectly.

customerHelpFaqs.question: How do I search for a hospital on MediTrust?
customerHelpFaqs.answer: On the homepage or Hospital Results page, type the hospital name, city, treatment, or specialty into the search bar. You can also click "Use My Location" to automatically discover the nearest hospitals sorted by distance.

customerHelpFaqs.question: How does the "Search by Health Problem" feature work?
customerHelpFaqs.answer: If you are experiencing specific symptoms or need a particular procedure (such as chest pain, fracture, or pediatric care), enter your condition in the Health Problem page. MediTrust matches your query with hospitals that have certified departments and active facilities to treat that condition.

customerHelpFaqs.question: Are hospital ratings and ER wait times updated in real time?
customerHelpFaqs.answer: Yes. MediTrust connects with partner hospital triage networks to display estimated emergency room wait times and aggregates verified reviews from patients who checked in through the platform.

customerHelpFaqs.question: How do I get directions to a hospital?
customerHelpFaqs.answer: Click the "Get Directions" button on any hospital card or detail page. This highlights the facility on our interactive map and provides turn-by-turn routing directly from your current position.

customerHelpFaqs.question: What if I need an online doctor consultation instead of visiting a hospital?
customerHelpFaqs.answer: Click "Online Consultation" in the top navbar. You can search verified physicians by specialty, view their credentials, and book a secure video consultation without visiting a physical clinic.

customerHelpFaqs.question: Is MediTrust suitable for life-threatening emergencies?
customerHelpFaqs.answer: If you or someone around you is facing an immediate life-threatening emergency, call 911 immediately. MediTrust helps locate emergency-equipped hospitals, but 911 dispatch provides immediate paramedic assistance.
